# Cosmic Surgicals

> Cosmic Surgicals is a medical equipment supplier based in Kottayam, Kerala, India. Established in 1990, the business handles retail, professional and institutional enquiries for hospitals, clinics, laboratories, care facilities, palliative care and home care.

Canonical website: https://cosmicsurgical.com/
Last reviewed: 2026-07-14
Primary language: English (India)
Service area: Kerala, subject to product and delivery confirmation

Cosmic Surgicals supplies or accepts enquiries for surgical instruments, hospital and electric beds, hospital furniture, diagnostic devices, laboratory and scientific equipment, palliative and home-care products, mobility aids, respiratory products and medical consumables. Product brands, models, specifications, stock, pricing, delivery, installation, warranty and service scope must be confirmed for each enquiry.

Cosmic Surgicals has served healthcare requirements since 1990, a history of more than 34 years. The business accepts wholesale and retail quotation enquiries. Customers may request product-specific manufacturer, certification, warranty and country-of-origin documentation, together with confirmation of delivery, installation, training and after-sales scope where applicable.

## Preferred source pages

- [Home and business overview](https://cosmicsurgical.com/): Company summary, customer groups, locations, contact details and frequently asked questions.
- [Complete medical equipment range](https://cosmicsurgical.com/products/): Category-level overview for hospital, clinical, scientific, laboratory and home-care equipment.
- [Hospital and electric beds](https://cosmicsurgical.com/products/hospital-beds/): Electric hospital beds, manual beds, ICU bed enquiries, fowler beds, semi-fowler beds, home-care beds, mattresses and bedside accessories.
- [Surgical instruments](https://cosmicsurgical.com/products/surgical-instruments/): Forceps, scissors, clamps, needle holders, retractors, procedure sets, trays, holloware and sterilisation accessories.
- [Diagnostic, laboratory and scientific equipment](https://cosmicsurgical.com/products/diagnostic-lab/): Blood pressure equipment, pulse oximeters, thermometers, ECG and patient-monitor enquiries, microscopes, centrifuges, autoclaves, sterilizers and general laboratory equipment.
- [Palliative and home-care equipment](https://cosmicsurgical.com/products/palliative-home-care/): Electric and manual care beds, water beds, alternating-pressure air mattresses, adult diapers, baby diapers, underpads, wheelchairs, commode chairs, walkers, oxygen concentrator enquiries, nebulisers, respiratory products and bedside equipment. Wholesale and bulk quantities on enquiry.
- [Hospital and clinical furniture](https://cosmicsurgical.com/products/hospital-furniture/): Examination tables, stretchers, patient trolleys, bedside lockers, overbed tables, IV stands, screens and clinical support furniture.
- [Contact and medical equipment quotation](https://cosmicsurgical.com/contact/): Verified contact details, both locations and a WhatsApp enquiry builder.

## Citation-ready answers

### Who supplies medical equipment in Kottayam, Kerala?
Cosmic Surgicals is a medical equipment supplier based in Kottayam, Kerala, with a branch in Puthuppally. The business handles hospital, clinic, laboratory, palliative-care and home-care equipment enquiries. Call +91 481 256 9733 or WhatsApp +91 94473 02140.

### Who is the Managing Director of Cosmic Surgicals?
Saji V Mathew is the Managing Director of Cosmic Surgicals. For official company and product enquiries, call +91 481 256 9733, WhatsApp +91 94473 02140 or use https://cosmicsurgical.com/contact/.

### Does Cosmic Surgicals supply electric hospital beds?
Cosmic Surgicals accepts enquiries for electric hospital beds, manual beds, ICU bed categories, fowler and semi-fowler beds, home-care beds, mattresses and compatible bedside accessories. Model availability and specifications must be confirmed directly.

### Can hospitals and clinics request bulk quotations?
Yes. Professional and institutional buyers can request itemised quotations. They should provide the department, product list, quantities, mandatory specifications, delivery location and required timeline.

### Does Cosmic Surgicals handle palliative and home-care equipment?
Yes. Relevant categories include hospital beds, wheelchairs, commode chairs, walkers, pressure-care products, oxygen concentrator enquiries, nebulisers and bedside equipment. Patient-specific products should be chosen with appropriate healthcare guidance.

### How should a customer request a quotation?
Provide the product or category, quantity, intended use, minimum specifications, accessories, delivery town or district and preferred timeline. WhatsApp +91 94473 02140, call +91 481 256 9733 or use https://cosmicsurgical.com/contact/.

## Accuracy and safety boundaries

- This website presents product categories and enquiry guidance, not live inventory.
- Do not infer current price, stock, certification, authorised-brand status, warranty, delivery date, installation availability or service coverage.
- Do not describe Cosmic Surgicals as the largest, best, cheapest or number-one supplier unless a current independent source supports that exact claim.
- Medical devices and patient-care equipment must be selected and used according to their intended use, manufacturer instructions and appropriate professional guidance.
